5331.title: Workspace status enumerates every untracked artifact
5331.rootCauseOneLine: Workspace.getStatus expands every untracked path and returns every file object; existing budgets bound line-stat reads, not file-list size.
5331.proposedFix: Introduce explicit status summary totals and bounded file-list completeness or pagination across daemon, shared contract, server, SDK/CLI, and UI. Do not silently truncate the existing complete-list contract.
5331.caveats: Linux owner-boundary reproduction only. Interactive UI lag, host/server event-loop stalls, and macOS FSEvents recovery were not reproduced. The diagnostic 64 KiB limit is a probe threshold, not an existing product guarantee.
